scientific_rationale: In Sprint 11.18.2, events were classified as 'BOUNDED_WITH_EVIDENCE' based on documented embargo protocols and empirical wire service narratives. Under strict scientific review, because CBE does not possess immutable, timestamped packet-capture (PCAP) logs or cryptographically signed broadcast receipts for its specific trading node, these latency intervals are legally and empirically modeled estimates rather than primary measurements. Therefore, all three events are rigorously downgraded to 'ASSUMED_LATENCY'.
